$comment: Pre-approved permissions so a fresh clone works without prompting on every step.
Every entry here is a STANDING GRANT — commands run without asking. Read a diff to
this file the way you would read a diff to sudoers. See SECURITY.md.
Deliberately absent: git push, git commit, and any bare Bash. Publishing is a
human decision, and this project's repo holds an allowlist protecting personal
data. Personal conveniences belong in settings.local.json, which is not committed.
